scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,desktop -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "wait-on tcp:5000 tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build --prefix client && electron-builder --win nsis
